article.title: Microsoft開放AI素材標示控制，可批次管理聲明
article.summary: Microsoft Advertising宣布AI內容透明度控制正式可用，讓廣告主申報圖像及影片中的AI生成內容。
highlights: 支援的格式可選擇可見浮水印，實際控制按廣告格式及工作流程而異。
素材聲明可經Ads Studio素材庫、API及商品資料源更新。
article.why: 素材披露加入批次管理，廣告營運團隊可把生成來源與上架欄位連結，決定哪些資產需要更新聲明。
article.next_step: 先抽查一批AI圖像及影片，把製作來源、素材聲明和實際版位的浮水印呈現逐項對照。
article.detail: Microsoft表示，平台的AI偵測訊號可作參考，廣告主仍需自行決定及負責內容聲明。控制涵蓋多種廣告格式，浮水印大小和位置亦可能隨版位改變。團隊可以把同一素材在素材庫、商品資料源及廣告預覽中的狀態並列，確認批次更新沒有遺漏版本或錯置生成來源。
article.title_en: Microsoft opens AI creative disclosures with bulk declaration controls
article.summary_en: Microsoft Advertising says AI content transparency controls are generally available for declaring generated images and video.
highlights_en: Visible watermarks are offered where supported, with controls varying by format and workflow.
Declarations can be updated through Ads Studio Library, APIs and product feeds.
article.why_en: Ad operations can connect production provenance with asset fields to decide which declarations need updating.
article.next_step_en: Compare provenance, declarations and rendered watermarks for a sample of AI images and videos.
article.detail_en: Microsoft says detection signals are a reference and advertisers remain responsible for declarations. Watermark size and placement vary. Compare each asset's library, feed and ad-preview states to catch missing versions or incorrect source flags during bulk updates.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
